mapper.sql: p.id, p.workspace_id, p.code, p.name, p.description, p.color, p.visibility, p.status, p.archived_at, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM knowledge_assets a WHERE a.project_id=p.id) AS assets, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM research_runs r WHERE r.project_id=p.id) AS runs, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM reports r2 WHERE r2.project_id=p.id) AS reports
mapper.select: SELECT FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.status <> 'DELETED' AND (p.visibility = 'WORKSPACE' OR p.created_by = #{userId}) ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.status <> 'DELETED' AND (p.visibility = 'WORKSPACE' OR p.created_by = #{userId})
SELECT created_by FROM projects WHERE id=#{projectId} AND status <> 'DELETED'

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND p.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' AND (p.created_by=#{userId} OR wm.role IN ('OWNER','ADMIN')))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (workspace_id, code, name, description, color, visibility, created_by) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{color}, '#14b8a6'), #{visibility}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET name=#{name}, description=#{description}, color=COALESCE(#{color}, color), visibility=#{visibility}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND status <> 'DELETED'

UPDATE projects SET status=#{status}, archived_at=CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ARCHIVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{projectId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE')
